I started with hardware

At first I used built and repaired machines. That is where I wrote my first real system: an internal management tool in PHP with PostgreSQL.

Then came the servers

I spent over a year between Linux, Windows Server and Active Directory, reading incident logs and taking repetitive tasks off the team's hands with scripts.

Today, APIs that run well

When I build an API in Spring Boot, I think about how it will run on the server. Since January 2026 I have worked with freelance clients, and I study Information Systems at FHO.
